name: GSM1k
description: A contamination-aware replication of GSM8K containing 1,000 grade-school math problems constructed to mirror the style, complexity, and human solve rates of GSM8K while consisting entirely of novel problems. Designed to measure the 'memorization gap' — whether high GSM8K scores reflect genuine reasoning or training data contamination. Reveals accuracy drops up to 8% in some model families with a positive correlation (r²=0.36) between contamination probability and performance gap.
typical_sota_score: Frontier models (GPT-4, Claude): <1% drop; some model families (Phi, Mistral): up to 8% accuracy drop vs. GSM8K
reputation: Published at NeurIPS 2024; key contamination detection benchmark; widely cited in contamination research; validated that frontier model generalization claims need verification; provides clean GSM8K equivalent for ongoing evaluation
notes: NeurIPS 2024. Positive correlation (Spearman r²=0.36) between a model's probability of generating GSM8K examples verbatim and its performance gap on GSM1k — direct evidence of contamination. Frontier models (GPT-4, Claude) show minimal drops, validating their generalization. Some mid-tier models show drops up to 8%, suggesting memorization was inflating their apparent capabilities. GSM8K-Platinum (2025) is a separately cleaned variant addressing answer label errors.
